t: This is The Burghers of Calais, a sculpture by Auguste Rodin. Rodin is considered a founder of modern sculpture. The art school he wanted to attend turned him down three times, so he trained at an applied arts school and in studios and workshops around Paris. He only won public attention and commissions of his own in his late thirties. He's known for boldly expressive, emotional figures, and besides this work, for The Kiss, The Gates of Hell and the Monument to Balzac.
